text:
sara: heads-up — i'm planning a small infra change to the 'user-sync' deployment to reduce pod churn during short traffic spikes. i'll open a PR in ~1h. TL;DR: add podAntiAffinity (preferred), tighten cpu requests/limits for burst handling, set rollingUpdate maxSurge=1/maxUnavailable=0, and bump readinessProbe initialDelay to 8s. anyone see blockers?

mike: ping me when you open the PR, i'll take a look. quick q: why maxUnavailable=0? seems conservative.

sara: want to avoid simultaneous terminations during our 10m canary window — new pods should come up before we kill old ones. with maxSurge=1 we still allow an extra pod for the switch.

jon: is user-sync a Deployment or StatefulSet? surge isn't supported for StatefulSet.

sara: Deployment. we've moved its storage to NFS (ReadWriteMany) so it's safe.

carol: +1 on preferred anti-affinity rather than required. if cluster is nearly full requiredDuringScheduling... will block scheduling. prefer weight 50.

sara: yup planned preferred. rough manifest snippet i'll put in the PR:```yaml
spec:
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  template:
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
          - weight: 50
            podAffinityTerm:
              topologyKey: "kubernetes.io/hostname"
              labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app: user-sync
      containers:
      - name: user-sync
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: "200m"
            memory: "256Mi"
          limits:
            cpu: "1000m"
            memory: "1Gi"
      readinessProbe:
        httpGet:
          path: /health
          port: 8080
        initialDelaySeconds: 8
        periodSeconds: 5
```

mike: requests=200m seems low if we get short bursts, do we have HPA? and what's minReplicas?

sara: HPA exists (custom throughput metric). minReplicas is 2, target CPU 70%. i've added a PodDisruptionBudget minAvailable: 2 to keep capacity during voluntary evictions.

jon: consider adding topologySpreadConstraints too so pods spread across AZs, not just host. helps if an AZ degrades.

carol: also remember to update the terraform resource (we manage k8s manifests via k8s_manifest in infra repo). add an explicit lifecycle ignore for metadata.annotations we don't manage, and include the plan output in the PR so ops can review schedule impacts.

sara: good call. will include terraform plan, k8s manifest diff, and a note about scheduling risk. tagging infra owners in the PR. cc @dave for any SRE objections.

dave: :eyes: i'll review for SLI impact. ensure ingress health checks tolerate the slightly longer readiness initialDelay during rollout.

deploy-bot: preview created — https://ci.internal/pipelines/12345/changes/preview (contains k8s manifest diff + terraform plan).

mike: nice. if reviewer load is low i'll merge after you address comments.

sara: thanks everyone — opening PR now and will drop the link here.
